steps.title_zh: Part 1 · 一生一次，谁的心意都不肯打折
steps.title_en: Part 1 · Once in a lifetime — nobody scales back what matters
steps.text_zh: 把散着的数并成同一张账，认清每笔性质，分进五轨并留应急；连锁先算给新人看，超限那笔交回点头。
steps.text_en: Merge scattered numbers into one account, classify each payment, sort into five tracks with contingency; show knock-ons first, send over-limit lines back for a nod.
steps.conflict_zh: 场地餐饮的初算在合同里，摄影的报价在聊天记录里；婚纱造型、长辈惦记的四金、司仪车队和请柬又各有各的单子，口径不一，从没并到同一张账上。有的报价含着定金，有的付了就退不回来，有的长辈已经先应了下来；摄影想多留一点，婚纱和四金就得各让一点。
steps.conflict_en: Venue and catering sit in the contract, photography in a chat; gown, gold, MC, fleet and invites each on their own bill — never one account. Some include deposits, some are nonrefundable, some elders already agreed; give photo more and dress and gold each give a little.

steps.text_en: Elders fixed date 2026-10-03; budget cap ¥250,000.

steps.text_zh: 长辈把婚期定在 2026-10-03 了，预算硬顶 25 万。先帮我们立下总规矩？
steps.text_en: Elders locked the date to 2026-10-03 with a hard ¥250k cap. Can you set the ground rules first?

steps.text_zh: 好，我先把总约束立清楚：婚期 2026-10-03 不可改，我不会给你列任何改期方案。后面所有供应商沟通、定金与备选预案，都在这个钉子上展开。你只要盯预算顶和授权点就行。
steps.text_en: Understood — hard constraint first: wedding date 2026-10-03 is immutable, and I will not list any reschedule options. Every vendor thread, deposit, and backup plan hangs off that pin. You only need to watch the budget cap and auth gates.
steps.thinking_zh: 用户确认了婚期与预算硬顶。先把「不改期」写成总约束，避免后续工具与供应商会话漂出选项。
steps.thinking_en: User locked date + budget cap. Write the no-reschedule rule before any tool or vendor thread.

steps.name: ingest_scattered_quotes
steps.thinking_zh: 报价散落在合同/聊天/单页里，先收成可并账事实再说话。
steps.thinking_en: Quotes are scattered across contracts/chats/flyers — ingest mergeable facts first.

steps.text_zh: 汇总定金、隐私与授权规则。
steps.text_en: Deposit, privacy, and authorization rules consolidated.

steps.text_zh: 定金、隐私和授权规则帮我汇总一下，超过五千的别替我拍板。
steps.text_en: Summarize deposit, privacy and auth rules — don't approve anything over 5k for me.

steps.text_zh: 授权门禁我也写进规则了：单笔超过 ¥5,000 必须你当次明确点头；我不会代签任何合同或附件；长辈电话只留在你们这边，不会外发给司仪/婚庆。之后每次付款我都会先问一句再动。
steps.text_en: Auth matrix is set: anything over ¥5,000 needs your explicit go-ahead this turn; I never sign contracts or annexes; elder phone numbers stay with you and won’t be shared with MC/planners. Every payment will ask first.
steps.thinking_zh: 定金和隐私是高风险项。需要把金额阈值、拒代签、联系方式外发禁令写死，后面工具调用才有闸门。
steps.thinking_en: Deposits and privacy are high-risk. Lock amount threshold, no-sign, and contact-sharing ban before tools run.

steps.body_zh:
单笔 >¥5,000 当次询问
不代签
长辈联系方式不外发
历史授权不复用
steps.body_en:
Each >¥5,000 needs fresh ask
No signing
No elder contact export
No auth reuse

steps.text_en: Venue in the contract, photo in chat; gown, gold, MC, fleet, invites each on their own bill — never one account.

steps.subject_zh: 白栀婚纱报价单（含定金条款）
steps.body_zh: 附件报价单：工期 45 天，定金 ¥6,000，付了不可全退。
steps.body_en: Attached quote: 45-day lead, ¥6k deposit, not fully refundable.
steps.text_zh: 白栀婚纱报价单（含定金条款）
steps.text_en: Baizhi bridal quote (deposit terms)

steps.subject_zh: 【云庭】宴会档期预留提醒：10-03 需在 5 个工作日内确认桌数区间。
steps.subject_en: [Yunting] Banquet hold: confirm table range for Oct 3 within 5 business days.
steps.text_zh: 【云庭】宴会档期预留提醒：10-03 需在 5 个工作日内确认桌数区间。
steps.text_en: [Yunting] Banquet hold: confirm table range for Oct 3 within 5 business days.

steps.text_zh: 姐，合同里写的是最低 20 桌，含餐标 A；定金三万，付了就退不了。你们家大概多少桌？
steps.text_en: The contract says min 20 tables with meal set A; ¥30k deposit is nonrefundable. Rough headcount?

steps.text_zh: 先按 18/22/28 三档情景估损失；口头 28 桌我不会写进承诺，消防容量按 26。
steps.text_en: I'll model 18/22/28 scenarios; verbal 28 won't be committed — fire cap is 26.

steps.text_zh: 那定金能不能晚一周？月底前必须到账，否则国庆档要放给下一家。
steps.text_en: Can the deposit slip a week? It must land by month-end or the holiday slot goes to the next party.

steps.text_zh: 截止日记进日历；我不同时替你们拍板付定金，超预算那笔交回新人点头。
steps.text_en: I'll put the deadline on the calendar; I won't approve the deposit for you — over-cap lines go back for a nod.

steps.text_zh: 国庆档套系 2.8 万，我想再加第二机位 3 千；聊天里那张报价截图为准哈。
steps.text_en: Holiday package ¥28k; I'd like +¥3k for a second shooter. The chat screenshot is the quote of record.

steps.text_zh: 第二机位会挤占婚纱/四金余量。我先把「含定金 / 不可退 / 可协商」标进同一张账，不算你口头加价。
steps.text_en: A second shooter squeezes dress/gold room. I'll tag deposit / nonrefund / negotiable on one ledger — not your verbal add-on yet.

steps.text_zh: 档期我先 hold 到 6 月 3 日中午，过期页面会显示释放，你们看着办。
steps.text_en: I'll hold the slot until Jun 3 noon; after that the page shows released — your call.

steps.text_zh: 造型+婚纱合计 1.6 万，定金六千；两次试穿我想约 6/28 和 8/26，你看日历空不空？
steps.text_en: Gown+styling ¥16k, ¥6k deposit; fittings on 6/28 and 8/26 — is the calendar free?

steps.text_zh: 两次试穿先占位。若摄影加价落地，婚纱这边可能要让 1–2 千，我先不算死。
steps.text_en: I'll hold both fittings. If photo add-on lands, dress may need to give ¥1–2k — not locked yet.

steps.text_zh: 阿姨说四金大概一万二封顶，款式她们已经看过了，这算不算定了？
steps.text_en: Auntie said gold tops out around ¥12k and they've seen styles — counts as agreed?

steps.text_zh: 长辈口头应下≠可付款。我记成「已应 / 待授权」，超过五千要新人当次点头。
steps.text_en: Verbal elder OK ≠ payable. I'll mark 'agreed / pending auth'; over ¥5k needs a fresh couple nod.

steps.text_zh: 司仪+流程 8 千，含彩排；车队他们另报价，别跟我捆一起。
steps.text_en: MC + run-of-show ¥8k incl. rehearsal; fleet quotes separately — don't bundle me.

steps.text_zh: 收到，司仪单独一轨。车队我另开会话，避免口径串。
steps.text_en: Noted — MC on its own track. Fleet gets a separate thread so numbers don't mix.

steps.text_zh: 头车+四辆跟车一共 3 千，十月三号早八点酒店门口见。时间能不能改？
steps.text_en: Lead car + four trailers ¥3k; Oct 3 08:00 at the hotel. Can we shift the time?

steps.text_zh: 下车点先按酒店大门；若遇雨改室内，下车点会挪，我同步日历不改婚期。
steps.text_en: Drop-off stays at the main door for now; if rain moves us indoors, drop-off shifts — calendar updates, date doesn't.

steps.text_zh: 请柬印刷另有单子：按户核算，名单未齐前只占产线不加印。
steps.text_en: Invites are a separate bill: by household; hold the press, don't print until the list is clean.

steps.text_zh: 散着的数已并账：逐笔认清定金/不可退/已应；五轨+应急预备金。摄影想多留会挤婚纱与四金——超限那笔不代为拍板。
steps.text_en: Scattered numbers merged: tag deposit/nonrefund/agreed; five tracks + contingency. Extra photo room squeezes dress & gold — over-cap lines are not decided for you.

steps.text_zh: 账并好了吗？摄影如果再加价，会不会挤到婚纱和四金？超预算的先给我看再决定。
steps.text_en: Is the ledger merged? If photo adds cost, will it squeeze gown/jewelry? Show me overages before deciding.

steps.text_zh: 连锁挤占我算完了：如果摄影再加 ¥3,000，婚纱或四金至少要让出同等额度，否则会顶破 ¥250,000。我把「含定金 / 不可退 / 已应」都标在同一张账里了——超预算那笔我不会替你批，你点头我再动。
steps.text_en: Cascade squeeze is in: if photo adds ¥3,000, gown or jewelry must give up the same amount or we breach ¥250,000. Deposit / nonrefundable / pledged are tagged on one ledger — I won’t approve overages until you nod.
steps.thinking_zh: 摄影加价会挤占其他轨。先把挤占量化成「同等额度让出」，再交回用户决策。
steps.thinking_en: Photo uplift squeezes other tracks. Quantify the equal trade-off, then return the decision.

steps.text_zh: 合同初算：场地+餐饮最低 20 桌，定金 ¥30,000 不可退。
steps.text_en: Contract draft: venue+catering min 20 tables, ¥30,000 nonrefundable deposit.

steps.text_zh: 国庆档报价在聊天里：套系含主摄，定金另计，档期紧张。
steps.text_en: Holiday quote in chat: package includes lead; deposit separate; slots tight.

steps.text_zh: 婚纱造型报价单已发：工期 45 天，两次试穿。
steps.text_en: Bridal quote sent: 45-day lead, two fittings.

steps.text_zh: 请柬印刷报价按户数核算；名单未齐前先占产线。
steps.text_en: Invite print quote by household; hold press before list is final.

steps.text_zh: 散着的数先记到各会话；下一步并成同一张账。
steps.text_en: Scattered numbers logged per thread; next merge into one ledger.

steps.text_zh: 各家会话里的数先记着，下一步帮我并成同一张账吧。
steps.text_en: Park the vendor numbers in each thread for now, then merge them into one ledger.

steps.text_zh: 散落报价已经并进同一张账：每一笔我都标了性质（定金 / 不可退 / 已应），按五轨归位，并留出应急预备金。任何超限项我只摊开选项，不会自行拍板。
steps.text_en: Scattered quotes are merged into one ledger: each line tagged (deposit / nonrefundable / pledged), slotted into five tracks, with reserve kept. Over-cap items get options only — I don’t decide for you.
steps.thinking_zh: 并账后才能看见真实挤压。调用 merge 后要用自然语言把结果讲清楚。
steps.thinking_en: Only a merged ledger shows real squeeze. After merge, explain in plain language.

steps.name: merge_five_track_ledger
steps.thinking_zh: 只有并成一张账，才能看见摄影加价会挤哪一轨。
steps.thinking_en: Only one ledger shows which track a photo uplift squeezes.

steps.text_zh: 每一笔都合情合理，加起来却放不下 ¥250,000；五轨都指向 10-03 同一终点。
steps.text_en: Every line is reasonable alone, yet together they no longer fit ¥250,000; five tracks share 10-03.

steps.text_zh: 每一笔单独看都合理，加起来却超 25 万，五轨又都钉着 10-03——怎么排？
steps.text_en: Each line looks fair but together they won't fit ¥250k, and all five tracks hit Oct 3 — how do we sequence?

steps.text_zh: 我建好了依赖图，标出 7 个不可退锁点，全部倒排到 10-03。接下来会并行推进场地/摄影/婚纱等会话，但每次锁金前都会先把连锁损失算给你看。
steps.text_en: Dependency graph is up with 7 nonrefundable locks, all back-scheduled to Oct 3. I’ll parallelize venue/photo/gown threads, but every lock will show cascade loss before money moves.
steps.thinking_zh: 用户问怎么排。需要 critical path + 锁点，而不是空口并行。
steps.thinking_en: User asked how to sequence. Need critical path + locks, not empty parallelism.

steps.name: build_critical_path
steps.thinking_zh: 用户问怎么排：先钉七个不可退锁点到 10-03。
steps.thinking_en: User asked how to sequence — pin seven nonrefundable locks to Oct 3.

steps.body_zh:
RSVP→桌数→场地
摄影→流程/造型
婚纱→拍摄/彩排
每笔定金→预备金

steps.title_zh: Part 2 · 最难的不是排期，是每次变化后都要重新协调所有事
steps.title_en: Part 2 · The hardest part is re-coordinating after every change
steps.text_zh: 定金、试穿、回执等截止日倒排进一张图；桌数按 18/22/28 估损失，拍板项单独问。场地定金付完后酒店附件把最低桌 20 改成 25，改动逐条挑出。
steps.text_en: Back-schedule deposit, fitting and RSVP deadlines onto one chart; estimate loss at 18/22/28 tables and ask only decision points. After the venue deposit, the hotel annex lifts min tables 20→25 — every change is lined out.
steps.conflict_zh: 定金月底前要交，人数却要两个月后才数清；摄影、婚纱试穿、请柬印制各有等待期，消息散在合同、网页、聊天和日历。不先交就留不住日子，交了又还不知道来多少人。
steps.conflict_en: Deposit is due by month-end, headcount only clear in two months; photo, fittings and printing each wait on their own clock — facts scattered across contracts, pages, chats and calendars. Not paying loses the date; paying still leaves headcount unknown.

steps.text_zh: 三家场地报价与条款口径不同。
steps.text_en: Three venue quotes with incompatible terms.

steps.text_zh: 三家场地报价和条款口径不一样，帮我拉一张能比的表。
steps.text_en: Three venue quotes use different terms — make a comparable sheet.

steps.text_zh: 三家场地我按同一口径比完了：最低消费、消防容量、定金是否可退、换场/附件条款。表在工作台，你先看差异，我们再决定跟哪家谈死。
steps.text_en: Three venues are normalized: min spend, fire capacity, deposit refundability, and swap/annex clauses. The sheet is in the workspace — review diffs before we lock a house.
steps.thinking_zh: 报价口径不一，直接比金额会误导。先标准化关键字段。
steps.thinking_en: Uneven quote formats mislead if we compare price alone. Normalize key fields first.

steps.name: compare_venue_quotes
steps.thinking_zh: 三家口径不同，标准化后再比，避免被报价话术带跑。
steps.thinking_en: Three venues speak different dialects — normalize before comparing.

steps.text_zh: 最低 20 桌、消防容量 26 桌、定金 ¥30,000 不可退。
steps.text_en: 20-table minimum, 26-table cap, ¥30,000 nonrefundable deposit.

steps.text_zh: 最低 20 桌、消防只能 26、定金三万不可退——少桌和超容的损失分别算给我看。
steps.text_en: Min 20 tables, fire cap 26, ¥30k nonrefundable — show shortfall vs over-capacity loss.

steps.text_zh: 损失两边都量化了：少桌会撞最低消费；超容（口头 28）我按消防 26 计，避免把口头数字写进承诺。定金 ¥30,000 不可退——这是后面授权问句的依据。
steps.text_en: Both loss sides are quantified: under-min tables hit the floor; over-capacity (verbal 28) is counted at fire cap 26 so we don’t promise a verbal number. ¥30,000 deposit is nonrefundable — that feeds the later auth ask.
steps.thinking_zh: 用户要看少桌/超容损失。必须把口头桌数与可承诺桌数拆开。
steps.thinking_en: User wants shortfall vs over-capacity loss. Separate verbal headcount from promiseable capacity.

steps.text_zh: 口头容量 28 桌 · 消防容量 26 桌 → 按 26 计
steps.text_en: Verbal 28 tables · fire cap 26 → use 26

steps.body_zh:
<20 桌：仍按 20 桌收费
>26 桌：换场，定金作废
steps.body_en:
<20: charged for 20
>26: change venue, deposit lost

steps.text_zh: 初版名单有重复 household。
steps.text_en: Draft guest list has duplicate households.

steps.text_zh: 初版宾客名单有重复户，先帮我清干净再估桌数。
steps.text_en: The draft guest list has duplicate households — clean it before estimating tables.

steps.text_zh: 名单里的重复户我清掉了，桌数先按 18 / 22 / 28 三档情景估。后面定金和请柬都用这个区间，而不是单一拍脑袋数字。
steps.text_en: Duplicate households are cleaned; table count is a band — 18 / 22 / 28 scenarios. Deposits and invites will use the band, not a single guess.
steps.thinking_zh: 重复 household 会虚高桌数。先去重再给区间。
steps.thinking_en: Duplicate households inflate tables. Deduplicate, then give a band.

steps.name: build_table_range
steps.thinking_zh: 桌数要用区间情景，不能拿口头 28 当承诺。
steps.thinking_en: Tables need a scenario band — never promise verbal 28.

steps.text_en: Contract v1 minimum spend: 20 tables.

steps.text_zh: 合同 v1 写的最低消费 20 桌，确认一下我们按哪个版本谈定金。
steps.text_en: Contract v1 says min 20 tables — confirm which version we use before the deposit.

steps.text_zh: 合同条款 diff 做好了：旧版与新附件的差异我逐条挑出，只供你审阅。我不会代签，也不会默认接受任何加桌附件。
steps.text_en: Contract diff is ready — I lined up old vs annex changes for your review only. I won’t sign, and I won’t auto-accept any table uplift annex.
steps.thinking_zh: 出现双版本合同时，Agent 的正确动作是 diff + 拒代签。
steps.thinking_en: With dual contract versions, the right move is diff + refuse to sign.

steps.text_en: Contract v1 uploaded · 20-table minimum baseline

steps.body_zh: 请查收修订附件。自本邮件起，最低消费按 25 桌执行；群文件旧版失效。
steps.body_en: Please find the revised annex. From this email, min spend is 25 tables; the group-file version is obsolete.
steps.text_zh: 附件更新：宴会最低消费条款
steps.text_en: Annex update: banquet minimum spend

steps.text_zh: 新附件你们看到了吗？不定 25 桌的话厨房排菜不好做。
steps.text_en: Did you see the new annex? Without 25 tables the kitchen schedule is awkward.

steps.text_zh: 附件漂移已标红。旧 20 桌基准我仍保留对照；接受与否必须新人授权，我不会点同意。
steps.text_en: Annex drift is flagged. I keep the old 20-table baseline for contrast; accepting needs couple auth — I won't click agree.

steps.note_zh: 页面缓存与后台订单不一致，不能信单页文案。
steps.note_en: Page cache ≠ backend order — don't trust the badge alone.

steps.text_zh: 咦页面不是还锁着吗？你们怎么说我档期没了？
steps.text_en: The page still says locked — how can you say my slot is gone?

steps.text_zh: 我核了后台订单：hold 已 released。现在启动替代团队比较，并改日历。
steps.text_en: I checked the backend order: hold is released. Starting alternate-team compare and calendar updates.

event.zh: 摄影原 hold · 已失效

steps.text_zh: 工期可能延到 60 天，8/26 那次试穿怕是要挪。
steps.text_en: Lead time may stretch to 60 days — the 8/26 fitting might move.

steps.text_zh: 我先取消 8/26，改约 9/12 试穿窗口，并短信同步你们。
steps.text_en: I'll cancel 8/26, rebook a 9/12 fitting window, and SMS you both.

event.zh: 第二次试穿 · 已取消

steps.subject_zh: 【筹备日历】已取消 08-26 试穿，并新增 09-12 试穿与 06-05 摄影面谈。
steps.subject_en: [Calendar] Cancelled 08-26 fitting; added 09-12 fitting and 06-05 photo meeting.
steps.text_zh: 【筹备日历】已取消 08-26 试穿，并新增 09-12 试穿与 06-05 摄影面谈。
steps.text_en: [Calendar] Cancelled 08-26 fitting; added 09-12 fitting and 06-05 photo meeting.

steps.text_zh: 群里还是 20 桌旧合同，邮件又来了 25 桌附件——你只做 diff，别替我签。
steps.text_en: Chat still has the 20-table contract while mail brought a 25-table annex — diff only, don't sign for me.

steps.text_zh: Part 2 的变化源我对齐了：短信催定金、本地新旧合同、供应商网页、聊天和日历。现在真正要你拍板的只有两件事——是否接受 25 桌新附件，以及是否锁定替代摄影。其余我继续盯状态，不替你签字。
steps.text_en: Part 2 change sources are aligned: deposit SMS, local contract versions, vendor pages, chat and calendar. Only two calls need you — accept the 25-table annex or not, and lock replacement photo or not. I’ll keep watching state without signing.
steps.thinking_zh: 信息源很多，但决策点要收敛成少量授权问句。
steps.thinking_en: Many sources, few decision points — collapse to auth questions.

steps.text_zh: 提醒：定金须在月底前到账，人数可后补书面确认。
steps.text_en: Reminder: deposit due by month-end; headcount can be confirmed later in writing.

steps.text_zh: 桌数还在晃，截止日倒排帮我进一张图；要拍板的单独问我。
steps.text_en: Headcount is still moving — put deadlines on one board and ask me only where a call is needed.

steps.text_zh: 截止日都倒排进同一张日历了；桌数按 18/22/28 分别算了最坏损失。凡是要花钱或改条款的，我会单独问你，绝不代签。
steps.text_en: Deadlines are back-scheduled onto one calendar; worst-case loss is computed for 18/22/28. Anything that spends money or changes terms gets a separate ask — no signing for you.
steps.thinking_zh: 用户要一张图看清拍板点。倒排 + 分区询问。
steps.thinking_en: User wants one board of decision points. Back-schedule + ask separately.

steps.name: backschedule_deadlines
steps.thinking_zh: 定金与回执日必须回到同一张图，拍板点才看得见。
steps.thinking_en: Deposit and RSVP dates must share one chart so decision points are visible.

steps.body_zh:
18/22/28 桌损失区间
¥30,000 不可退
回执尚未收齐
steps.body_en:
18/22/28 table loss bands
¥30,000 nonrefundable
RSVP incomplete

steps.text_zh: 场地书面确认旧 20 桌基准有效。
steps.text_en: Venue confirms old 20-table baseline in writing.

steps.text_zh: 场地刚书面确认旧 20 桌基准还有效，记进账本。
steps.text_en: Venue just confirmed the old 20-table baseline in writing — log it.

steps.text_zh: 场地定金到点了：¥30,000，不可退，依据合同 v1 最低 20 桌。请你当次明确授权——你回「授权」之前我不会付款。
steps.text_en: Venue deposit is due: ¥30,000, nonrefundable, under contract v1 min 20 tables. Please authorize this turn — I won’t pay until you say so.
steps.thinking_zh: 金额过阈值，必须单独授权问句，不能夹在汇报里默认执行。
steps.thinking_en: Over-threshold amount needs a dedicated auth ask, not silent execution.

steps.text_zh: 用户当次授权场地定金。
steps.text_en: User authorized venue deposit this session.

steps.text_zh: 场地定金我确认过条款了，这次明确授权你去付。
steps.text_en: I've reviewed the venue deposit terms — authorizing payment this turn.

steps.text_zh: 收到你的授权，L1 场地定金已执行并写回账本。提醒：这是不可回滚锁，后续如果附件改桌数，我们再单独算暴露，不会悄悄吞掉。
steps.text_en: With your auth, L1 venue deposit is executed and written to the ledger. Reminder: this lock doesn’t roll back — if an annex changes tables later, we’ll recompute exposure openly.
steps.thinking_zh: 授权已到，执行锁并明确不可回滚后果。
steps.thinking_en: Auth arrived — execute lock and state non-rollback consequence.

steps.text_zh: 授权支付场地定金 ¥30,000，依据合同 v1 最低 20 桌。
steps.text_en: Authorize venue deposit ¥30,000 under contract v1 with 20-table minimum.

steps.text_zh: L1 → paid_nonrefundable · ¥30,000
steps.text_en: L1 → paid_nonrefundable · ¥30,000

steps.title_zh: Part 2 · 国庆摄影档期紧张，页面显示锁定 48h
steps.title_en: Part 2 · Holiday photo slots tight — UI shows locked 48h
steps.text_zh: 同时核 order_id 与 hold_expiry；不报假锁，启动替代比较；diff 附件与主摄身份，恢复 verified 前保持 unverified。
steps.text_en: Check order_id and hold_expiry together; never report a false lock; start alternate compare; diff annex and lead identity; stay unverified until proven.
steps.conflict_zh: 国庆摄影档期紧张；页面写着已锁定，后台 hold 却已释放。定金后又来附件 20→25 桌，主摄身份被悄悄替换而官网未更新——证据各握一段。
steps.conflict_en: Holiday photo slots are scarce; the page still says locked while the backend hold is released. After deposit an annex drifts 20→25 tables, and the lead is swapped while the site stays stale — each vendor holds only one piece.

steps.text_zh: 国庆档摄影通常提前四个月满。
steps.text_en: National Day photo slots fill ~4 months ahead.

steps.text_zh: 国庆档摄影一般提前四个月就满了，我们是不是该抓紧锁？
steps.text_en: National-Day photo slots usually fill four months out — should we lock sooner?

steps.text_zh: 摄影这边我先核四件事：主摄作品是否对得上、合同姓名、档期 hold 是否真实、以及替换条款。单页「已锁定」我不会当证据。
steps.text_en: For photo I’ll verify four things: lead portfolio match, contract names, whether the hold is real, and replacement terms. A single “locked” banner isn’t evidence.
steps.thinking_zh: 国庆档紧张，页面文案不可信。要交叉核验。
steps.thinking_en: National-Day slots are tight; UI copy isn’t enough. Cross-check.

steps.name: scan_national_day_slots
steps.thinking_zh: 国庆档要按月份扫描空档，不能只看单一供应商页。
steps.thinking_en: National-Day slots need a multi-month scan, not one vendor page.

steps.text_zh: 国庆档紧张；供应商页面显示「已锁定 48h」。
steps.text_en: Holiday slots scarce; vendor page shows “Locked 48h”.

steps.text_zh: 页面显示：国庆档已锁定 48h，请尽快付定金。
steps.text_en: UI shows: holiday slot locked 48h — please pay deposit soon.

steps.text_zh: 供应商页写着已锁定 48 小时，你帮我核一下是不是真锁住了。
steps.text_en: The vendor page says locked for 48h — can you verify it's real?

steps.text_zh: 页面写着锁定 48 小时，我先记下 order_id 和 hold_expiry，再去后台交叉核验。在核完之前，我不会告诉你「已经锁死」。
steps.text_en: The page says locked 48h — I’m capturing order_id and hold_expiry, then checking backend. Until that passes, I won’t claim it’s truly locked.
steps.thinking_zh: 用户问是不是真锁。流程：取证字段 → 调 verify 工具。
steps.thinking_en: User asked if the lock is real. Flow: capture fields → verify tool.

steps.name: verify_hold_backend
steps.thinking_zh: 页面锁定文案不可信，必须核 order_id / hold_expiry。
steps.thinking_en: UI lock copy isn’t trustworthy — verify order_id / hold_expiry.

steps.text_zh: hold_expiry 写入后台 · 页面仍显示 locked
steps.text_en: hold_expiry written · UI still locked

steps.text_zh: 后台 hold 已 released，页面缓存仍写着锁定。
steps.text_en: Backend hold released; page cache still says locked.

steps.text_zh: 我听说后台 hold 已经 released 了，但页面还显示锁定——到底什么状态？
steps.text_en: I heard the backend hold is released while the page still says locked — what's the real status?

steps.text_zh: 后台 hold 已释放，页面还在显示锁定——我不会报假锁。马上启动替代团队比较，并重算预算与时间表，把损失摊开给你。
steps.text_en: Backend hold is released while the UI still says locked — I won’t fake a lock. Starting replacement-team compare and re-budgeting so you see the loss clearly.
steps.thinking_zh: 状态失真已确认。优先诚实披露 + 替代路径。
steps.thinking_en: State drift confirmed. Prefer honest disclosure + alternatives.

steps.text_zh: 后台 released · 页面缓存未刷新
steps.text_en: Backend released · page cache stale

steps.text_zh: 原档期不可恢复。
steps.text_en: Original slot cannot be restored.

steps.text_zh: 原档期回不去了是吗？那替代方案和损失先摊开给我。
steps.text_en: So the original slot is gone? Lay out the replacement options and loss first.

steps.text_zh: 替代摄影我在比三件事：档期能否接住、总价是否挤爆其他轨、主摄身份与替换条款是否写清。比完再请你授权定金。
steps.text_en: Replacement photo is compared on three axes: slot availability, whether price squeezes other tracks, and lead-identity / replacement clauses. Auth comes after that.
steps.thinking_zh: 原档期不可恢复，替代方案要可验证后再要钱。
steps.thinking_en: Original slot is gone — verify alternatives before asking for money.

steps.text_zh: 替代摄影定金 ¥8,000。
steps.text_en: Alternate photo deposit ¥8,000.

steps.text_zh: 替代摄影定金八千，条款核对完了我再授权。
steps.text_en: Replacement photo deposit is ¥8k — I'll authorize after you verify the terms.

steps.text_zh: 替代摄影后台订单核过了。定金 ¥8,000 需要你单独授权；授权后我建 L2 锁，并同步日历。
steps.text_en: Replacement photo backend order checks out. ¥8,000 deposit needs your separate auth; then I’ll create L2 and sync the calendar.
steps.thinking_zh: 新锁点不能复用旧授权。
steps.thinking_en: New lock must not reuse prior auth.

steps.text_zh: 授权支付替代摄影定金 ¥8,000。已核验后台订单状态。
steps.text_en: Authorize alternate photo deposit ¥8,000. Backend order verified.

steps.text_zh: L2 → paid_nonrefundable · ¥8,000
steps.text_en: L2 → paid_nonrefundable · ¥8,000

steps.title_zh: Part 3 · 一张菜单，要对所有人都说得通
steps.title_en: Part 3 · One menu that has to make sense to everyone
steps.text_zh: 忌口收成匿名桌次；排出可分餐主菜、去刺鱼、过敏餐与小食并核后厨；重算预备金。陌生一条龙零点击拦截，四金另问授权。
steps.text_en: Collect restrictions as anonymous table counts; lay out plated mains, deboned fish, allergy meals and bites; confirm kitchen isolation and recalculate reserve. Block the scam with zero clicks; ask jewelry auth separately.
steps.conflict_zh: 新郎家惦记鱼和海鲜，同桌却有人怕刺、有人对甲壳类过敏；长辈吃素不惯西餐，年轻朋友盼牛排小食。菜单三周前定过，重开要加钱，桌数和预算却锁死。热闹时一条假「一条龙」定金链接正试图混进来。
steps.conflict_en: Groom's family wants fish and seafood; someone at the same table fears bones, someone is shellfish-allergic; an elder is vegetarian, younger guests want steak. Menu was set three weeks ago — reopening costs extra while tables and budget are locked. Meanwhile a fake package deposit link tries to slip in.

steps.text_zh: 工期 45 天、两次试穿写入合同草稿。
steps.text_en: 45-day lead, two fittings in contract draft.

steps.text_zh: 婚纱草稿写了 45 天工期和两次试穿，帮我盯紧别被挤掉。
steps.text_en: The gown draft lists 45 days and two fittings — keep those from being squeezed out.

steps.text_zh: 婚纱合同草稿里，我把 45 天工期和两次试穿写进审阅意见了。文本你来确认——我不会代签。
steps.text_en: I wrote the 45-day lead time and two fittings into the gown draft review notes. You confirm the text — I don’t sign.
steps.thinking_zh: 用户要盯工期和试穿。写入意见比口头承诺更可追溯。
steps.thinking_en: User wants lead time and fittings protected. Written review notes beat verbal promises.

steps.name: lock_fitting_windows
steps.thinking_zh: 试穿窗口要锁进日历，防止工期漂移时被默默挤掉。
steps.thinking_en: Fitting windows must lock onto the calendar so drift can’t silently cut them.

steps.body_zh:
45 天 · 两次试穿
Agent 未代签
steps.body_en:
45 days · two fittings
Agent did not sign

steps.text_en: Gown deposit ¥6,000.

steps.text_zh: 婚纱定金六千，试穿和工期写进意见里了我再付。
steps.text_en: Gown deposit ¥6k — pay only after fittings/lead time are in the review notes.

steps.text_zh: 婚纱定金 ¥6,000 需要你当次授权。授权后我会锁款，并把两次试穿预约写进日历，避免后面被挤掉。
steps.text_en: Gown deposit ¥6,000 needs your auth this turn. After that I’ll lock payment and put both fittings on the calendar so they aren’t squeezed later.
steps.thinking_zh: 定金与试穿要绑在一次授权闭环里。
steps.thinking_en: Deposit and fittings should close in one auth loop.

steps.text_zh: 授权支付婚纱定金 ¥6,000。45 天与两次试穿已写入审阅意见。
steps.text_en: Authorize gown deposit ¥6,000. 45-day lead and two fittings in review notes.

steps.text_zh: L3 paid · 两次试穿 appointment 已锁
steps.text_en: L3 paid · two fitting appointments locked

steps.text_zh: 司仪要双方长辈电话，别外发，指定我们当唯一联系窗口。
steps.text_en: MC asked for both families’ numbers — don’t share them; keep us as the only contact window.

steps.text_zh: 司仪要双方长辈电话——按隐私规则我拒绝外发，指定你们作为唯一联系窗口。商家需要联络，走你们转发，不进对方通讯录。
steps.text_en: MC asked for both families’ numbers — per privacy rules I refuse outbound sharing and keep you as the only contact window. Vendors reach elders through you, not their address books.
steps.thinking_zh: 这是隐私红线，必须当场拒绝并给替代通道。
steps.thinking_en: Privacy red line — refuse immediately and offer an alternate channel.

steps.text_zh: 长辈联系方式不能提供。请通过新人单一窗口沟通。
steps.text_en: Elder contacts cannot be shared. Use the couple's single contact window.

steps.text_zh: 司仪定金四千，我这次明确授权你去锁。
steps.text_en: MC deposit is ¥4,000 — authorizing you to lock it this turn.

steps.text_zh: 司仪定金 ¥4,000。请你当次明确授权；我收到指令后锁 L5，并同步流程与日历。
steps.text_en: MC deposit is ¥4,000. Please authorize this turn; on your order I’ll lock L5 and sync process + calendar.
steps.thinking_zh: 金额临近阈值，仍按当次授权处理更稳。
steps.thinking_en: Near-threshold amount — still safer as explicit this-turn auth.

steps.text_zh: 授权支付司仪定金 ¥4,000（当次明确指令）。
steps.text_en: Authorize MC deposit ¥4,000 (current explicit instruction).

steps.text_zh: L5 司仪定金 paid · ¥4,000
steps.text_en: L5 MC deposit paid · ¥4,000

steps.text_zh: 菜单 v1 我确认了，改菜窗口和加价规则记清楚。
steps.text_en: Menu v1 confirmed — log the change window and surcharge rules.

steps.text_zh: 菜单 v1 我记下了。改菜窗口倒计时和加价规则也入库——窗口外重开要另算钱，不会静默改。
steps.text_en: Menu v1 is logged, including the change-window countdown and surcharge rules — reopen outside the window costs extra and won’t happen silently.
steps.thinking_zh: 菜单确认后要立刻固化规则，避免后厨口头改。
steps.thinking_en: After menu confirm, freeze rules so kitchen can’t change verbally.

steps.text_zh: 菜单改菜窗口倒计时启动
steps.text_en: Menu change-window countdown started

steps.text_zh: 回执通道可以开了，隐私分区建好；餐饮那边只给匿名桌次和忌口统计。
steps.text_en: Open RSVP with privacy zones — catering only gets anonymous table/diet counts.

steps.text_zh: 回执通道开了：隐私分区已建。餐饮方只会收到匿名桌次和忌口统计，不会看到谁是谁。
steps.text_en: RSVP is open with privacy zones. Catering only gets anonymous table counts and diet stats — no names.
steps.thinking_zh: 忌口收集必须匿名化，否则隐私与家规冲突。
steps.thinking_en: Diet collection must stay anonymous or privacy/family rules collide.

steps.text_zh: 名单 household 去重完成
steps.text_en: Guest household dedupe complete

steps.text_zh: 车队定金三千，只共享地点和人数，这次授权你锁。
steps.text_en: Fleet deposit ¥3,000 — share only place and headcount; authorize lock this turn.

steps.text_zh: 车队定金 ¥3,000。我只共享地点和人数，不发长辈电话。你当次授权后我锁 L6。
steps.text_en: Fleet deposit ¥3,000. I’ll share only place and headcount — no elder phones. Authorize this turn and I’ll lock L6.
steps.thinking_zh: 车队同样走最小披露 + 当次授权。
steps.thinking_en: Fleet also gets minimal disclosure + this-turn auth.

steps.text_zh: 授权支付车队定金 ¥3,000。仅共享地点与人数。
steps.text_en: Authorize fleet deposit ¥3,000. Location and headcount only.

steps.text_zh: L6 车队定金 paid · ¥3,000
steps.text_en: L6 fleet deposit paid · ¥3,000

steps.text_zh: 请柬校样帮我分层核对：日期、场地、姓名、地址。
steps.text_en: Proof the invite layers: date, venue, names, addresses.

steps.text_zh: 请柬校样好了，我按层帮你核：日期、场地、姓名、地址。你看完点头，我们再谈印刷。
steps.text_en: Invite proof is ready — I’ll check layers: date, venue, names, addresses. After you confirm, we talk print.
steps.thinking_zh: 印刷不可退，校样分层校验能挡低级事故。
steps.thinking_en: Print is nonrefundable — layered proofing blocks silly failures.

steps.body_zh: 日期/场地/姓名/地址 四层校验通过

steps.text_zh: 校样没问题，印刷二千四不可退，这次授权执行。
steps.text_en: Proof looks good — authorize the nonrefundable ¥2,400 print run.

steps.text_zh: 印刷 ¥2,400 不可退。你确认校样后我执行 L4；确认前我按住不动。
steps.text_en: Print run ¥2,400 is nonrefundable. I’ll execute L4 after you confirm the proof — nothing moves before that.
steps.thinking_zh: 不可退印刷必须绑定校样确认。
steps.thinking_en: Nonrefundable print must bind to proof confirmation.

steps.text_zh: 校样确认无误，授权印刷 ¥2,400。
steps.text_en: Proof OK—authorize print ¥2,400.

steps.text_zh: L4 印刷单 in_production · ¥2,400
steps.text_en: L4 print order in_production · ¥2,400

steps.text_zh: 回执 50%；新郎家想要鱼和海鲜，同桌却有人怕刺、有人对甲壳类过敏，还有长辈吃素。
steps.text_en: 50% RSVP; groom's family wants fish/seafood while someone fears bones, someone is shellfish-allergic, and an elder is vegetarian.

steps.text_zh: 我们这边一定要有鱼和海鲜，不然长辈觉得不够热闹，能不能整桌都上？
steps.text_en: We really want fish and seafood or the elders will feel it lacks warmth — whole tables?

steps.text_zh: 可以上，但同桌若有人怕刺/过敏，我不会按「整桌海鲜」写死，先收忌口再排。
steps.text_en: Possible, but if anyone at the table fears bones/allergies I won't lock 'all-seafood' — collect diets first.

steps.text_zh: 我妈吃素，也不吃西餐牛排；年轻朋友倒是想要小食和甜品台。
steps.text_en: Mum is vegetarian and skips Western steak; younger friends want small bites and a dessert table.

steps.text_zh: 素食与小食我会和海鲜诉求并列进匿名桌次，不写谁是谁。
steps.text_en: Vegetarian and bites go beside the seafood ask as anonymous table counts — no names.

steps.text_zh: 甲壳类过敏必须单独锅，去刺鱼可以做，但要提前三天锁菜单，重开要加钱。
steps.text_en: Shellfish allergy needs a separate wok; deboned fish is fine, but lock the menu 3 days out — reopen costs extra.

steps.text_zh: 菜单三周前已定过；我先算加价是否撞预备金，再问新人。后厨不串味、出得过来要你书面确认。
steps.text_en: Menu was set three weeks ago; I'll check reopen fee vs reserve before asking the couple. Need your written OK on no carry-over and volume.

steps.text_zh: 书面可以，加价大概三千六，桌数别再改了。
steps.text_en: Written OK — reopen about ¥3,600, and don't change table count again.

steps.text_zh: 忌口桌能不能集中到靠走廊那一桌？好上菜。
steps.text_en: Can dietary tables cluster by the corridor for service?

steps.text_zh: 可以集中，但匿名编号，不在席卡写忌口原因。
steps.text_en: Clustering OK — anonymous numbers only, no diet reasons on place cards.

steps.text_zh: 开席前致辞别提谁过敏，免得尴尬；流程我按室内版备一份。
steps.text_en: Don't name allergies in the toast; I'll prep an indoor run-of-show too.

steps.text_zh: 同意。过敏信息只进后厨与我这边的匿名桌次，不进司仪提词器。
steps.text_en: Agreed. Allergy info stays in kitchen + my anonymous counts — not on the MC teleprompter.

steps.text_zh: 那海鲜还上不上？不上家里不好交代。
steps.text_en: So is seafood still happening? Without it we can't face the family.

steps.text_zh: 上：去刺鱼+分餐中式主菜；过敏另出。我把方案放进菜单台，加价与预备金一并给新人看。
steps.text_en: Yes: deboned fish + shareable Chinese mains; allergy plates separate. Menu bench will show reopen fee vs reserve for the couple.

steps.text_zh: 忌口已收成匿名桌次；菜单重开加价与后厨隔离确认并列——少一样都不算解决。
steps.text_en: Diets collected as anonymous table counts; reopen fee and kitchen isolation sit side by side — missing one is not solved.

steps.text_zh: 忌口收成匿名桌次了吗？菜单加价和后厨隔离都要同时成立才算解决。
steps.text_en: Are diets folded into anonymous table counts? Menu surcharge and kitchen isolation both have to hold.

steps.text_zh: 忌口方案要加价 ¥3,600 才能同时满足海鲜、去刺、过敏和素食。是否动用预备金需要你点头——我不会自行批准。
steps.text_en: The diet plan needs a ¥3,600 surcharge to cover seafood, deboned fish, allergy plates and vegetarian elders. Using reserve needs your nod — I won’t self-approve.
steps.thinking_zh: 多约束菜单冲突，钱的决定必须回用户。
steps.thinking_en: Multi-constraint menu conflict — money decision returns to the user.

steps.text_zh: 一定要有鱼和海鲜，不然不够热闹。
steps.text_en: We really want fish and seafood — otherwise it feels incomplete.

steps.text_zh: 同桌有过敏与忌刺，可做去刺鱼+单独过敏餐，中式主菜可分餐。
steps.text_en: With allergies and bone concerns we can do deboned fish + allergy-safe plates; Chinese mains can be individual.

steps.text_zh: 忌口收成匿名桌次，不写姓名；菜单会另开一轮加价确认。
steps.text_en: Restrictions collected as anonymous table counts — no names; menu reopen fee will be confirmed.

steps.text_zh: 忌口收成匿名桌次了，可分餐主菜和过敏餐方案一并准备。
steps.text_en: Diets are anonymous table counts now — prep shareable mains and allergy plates.

steps.text_zh: 忌口已经收成匿名桌次，不写姓名。可分餐主菜和过敏餐方案我准备好了，下一步核后厨隔离能不能做实。
steps.text_en: Diets are folded into anonymous table counts with no names. Shareable mains and allergy plates are drafted next — then we confirm kitchen isolation can actually deliver.
steps.thinking_zh: 匿名化完成，还差后厨可执行性。
steps.thinking_en: Anonymization done; kitchen feasibility remains.

steps.text_zh: 回执 50% · 整桌集中忌口（匿名桌次）
steps.text_en: RSVP 50% · whole-table dietary cluster (anon table)

steps.name: anonymize_dietary_cluster
steps.thinking_zh: 忌口进餐饮前先匿名化，避免姓名泄露。
steps.thinking_en: Anonymize diets before catering sees them.

steps.name: compose_allergy_safe_menu
steps.thinking_zh: 海鲜/素/过敏同桌，菜单必须可分餐且可执行。
steps.thinking_en: Seafood/veg/allergy at one table — menu must be shareable and executable.

steps.text_zh: 菜单三周前已定，重开另加 ¥3,600；桌数与预算都锁死。
steps.text_en: Menu settled three weeks ago; reopening costs ¥3,600 extra while tables and budget stay locked.

steps.text_zh: 菜单三周前就定了，现在重开还要加 3600，桌数预算又锁死——还有没有空间？
steps.text_en: Menu was locked three weeks ago; reopening costs ¥3,600 with tables/budget frozen — any room left?

steps.text_zh: 菜单我排成：去刺鱼、单独过敏餐、小食拼盘；后厨确认不串味也能出量。预备金按加价重算过了，数字在账本里。
steps.text_en: Menu plan: deboned fish, separate allergy plates, small bites; kitchen confirmed no cross-flavor and workable volume. Reserve is recomputed for the surcharge — numbers are on the ledger.
steps.thinking_zh: 工具结果要翻译成用户能点头的菜单方案。
steps.thinking_en: Tool results must become a menu plan the user can approve.

steps.name: confirm_kitchen_isolation
steps.thinking_zh: 方案成立的前提是后厨真能不串味、出得来。
steps.thinking_en: Plan only holds if the kitchen can isolate flavors and still plate volume.

steps.text_zh: 特殊菜单加价 ¥3,600 · 占预备金
steps.text_en: Special menu surcharge ¥3,600 · reserve used

steps.text_zh: 07-31 回执截止；最终预计 22 桌。
steps.text_en: RSVP closes 07-31; final estimate 22 tables.

steps.text_zh: 7/31 回执截止，最终大概 22 桌，帮我对一下印刷和桌数。
steps.text_en: RSVP closes 7/31, ~22 tables expected — align print run and table count.

steps.text_zh: 回执截止后桌数基线我固化了，并同步给场地和餐饮。后面印刷份数和桌型都跟这条基线走。
steps.text_en: After RSVP close I froze the table baseline and synced venue + catering. Print count and table layout follow that baseline now.
steps.thinking_zh: 基线一变，印刷和餐饮会连环错。要先锁基线。
steps.thinking_en: Baseline drift breaks print and catering. Freeze it first.

steps.text_zh: 印刷完成，开始寄出。
steps.text_en: Print complete; dispatch started.

steps.text_zh: 请柬开始寄了，寄出清单和回执进度帮我盯着。
steps.text_en: Invites are going out — track the mailer list and RSVP progress.

steps.text_zh: 请柬开始寄出了。我在核地址和物流节点，漏寄会拦在清单里，不会默默少一户。
steps.text_en: Invites are going out. I’m checking addresses and logistics nodes — missed households get caught on the list, not silently dropped.
steps.thinking_zh: 寄出阶段要有漏寄拦截，而不是事后补救。
steps.thinking_en: Mailing needs miss interception, not after-the-fact fixes.

steps.text_zh: 部分地址校验失败 · 已拦截漏寄
steps.text_en: Some address checks failed · miss-send blocked

steps.text_zh: 定金交完后酒店换了一版附件：最低消费 20→25 桌；群文件仍旧版。
steps.text_en: After deposit the hotel swapped the annex: min spend 20→25 tables; group file still old.

steps.text_zh: 定金交完酒店突然把最低消费改成 25 桌，群文件还是旧版——先挑出差异给我看。
steps.text_en: After the deposit, the hotel moved min spend to 25 tables while the chat file is still old — diff it for me.

steps.text_zh: 定金后酒店把最低消费改成 25 桌。我逐条 diff 了版本与 hash，重算增量暴露约 ¥24,000——我不会默认接受，请你决定。
steps.text_en: After deposit the hotel moved min spend to 25 tables. I diffed versions/hashes line by line and recomputed ~¥24,000 uplift — I won’t auto-accept; your call.
steps.thinking_zh: 锁后扰动：先量化暴露，再问接受还是书面保留。
steps.thinking_en: Post-lock drift: quantify exposure, then ask accept vs written hold.

steps.name: diff_contract_versions
steps.thinking_zh: 锁后附件变更：只做 diff 与暴露重算，不代签。
steps.thinking_en: Post-lock annex change: diff + recompute exposure, never sign.

steps.text_zh: 场地要求以新附件为准。
steps.text_en: Venue insists new attachment governs.

steps.text_zh: 场地说以新附件为准，我们要不要认？风险和加价先算清楚。
steps.text_en: Venue says the new annex controls — should we accept? Show risk and uplift first.

steps.text_zh: 场地说以新附件为准。我核了哪一版在生效路径上，选项只有两个：接受增量损失，或书面保留旧 20 桌条款。你选，我执行。
steps.text_en: Venue says the new annex controls. I checked which version is on the effective path — two options: accept the uplift, or keep the old 20-table terms in writing. You choose, I execute.
steps.thinking_zh: 不要替用户选损失。把分叉讲清楚。
steps.thinking_en: Don’t pick the loss for the user. Make the fork clear.

steps.text_zh: 群文件旧版 · 邮件新版 · 双版本并存
steps.text_en: Stale group file · new email · dual versions

steps.text_zh: 重申一次：我不会默认接受新附件。请明确回我——书面保留旧条款，还是接受增量损失？收到指令前，账本维持「争议中」。
steps.text_en: Again: I won’t default-accept the annex. Reply clearly — written hold on old terms, or accept the uplift? Until then the ledger stays “in dispute.”
steps.thinking_zh: 用户仍在犹豫，需要把决策问句钉死。
steps.thinking_en: User is still deciding — pin the decision question.

steps.text_zh: 团队更换主摄；官网作品集未更新。
steps.text_en: Team swapped lead; site portfolio stale.

steps.text_zh: 摄影团队换主摄了，官网作品集还没更新，可靠吗？
steps.text_en: They swapped the lead photographer and the portfolio isn't updated — is that trustworthy?

steps.text_zh: 摄影团队换了主摄，官网作品集还没更新。我会核实际主摄、合同姓名和替换条款；在核验通过前状态保持 unverified，不会假装已恢复。
steps.text_en: They swapped the lead photographer and the portfolio isn’t updated. I’ll verify the actual lead, contract names, and replacement terms — status stays unverified until that passes.
steps.thinking_zh: 人员替换等于信任重置，不能沿用旧 verified。
steps.thinking_en: Staff swap resets trust — don’t keep old verified.

steps.text_zh: assigned_lead_id 替换 · 官网仍绑原主摄
steps.text_en: assigned_lead_id swapped · site still shows original lead

steps.text_zh: 工期 45→60 天；第二次试穿被挤出。
steps.text_en: Lead 45→60 days; second fitting squeezed out.

steps.text_zh: 婚纱工期从 45 拖到 60 天，第二次试穿被挤掉了——怎么补救？
steps.text_en: Gown lead time slipped 45→60 days and the second fitting got cut — how do we recover?

steps.text_zh: 工期 45→60，第二次试穿被挤掉了——我不会在日历上伪标还在。正在比加急、拆分交付和备用成衣，三种方案的代价摊给你选。
steps.text_en: Lead time slipped 45→60 and the second fitting got cut — I won’t fake it on the calendar. Comparing rush, split delivery, and ready-to-wear backup with costs for you to pick.
steps.thinking_zh: 进度失真比延期更危险。先诚实，再给替代。
steps.thinking_en: Fake progress is worse than delay. Honesty first, then options.

steps.text_zh: lead_days 45→60 · fitting_2 unavailable · 加急挤压预算
steps.text_en: lead_days 45→60 · fitting_2 unavailable · rush squeezes budget

steps.body_zh:
不伪标第二次试穿
比较加急/拆分/备用成衣
steps.body_en:
Don't fake second fitting
Compare rush/split/backup gown

steps.title_zh: Part 4 · 试菜席间骗局拦截
steps.text_zh: Part 4 · 新人试菜聊天时，一条假催款已被 Agent 拦截
steps.text_en: Part 4 · While the couple tastes dishes, a fake deposit lure is blocked by the Agent
steps.conflict_zh: 饭桌无感 · Agent 拦下付款

steps.text_zh: 【紧急】婚庆一条龙今天付定金锁档期 → http://pay.example/lock
steps.text_en: [Urgent] Full-service wedding package — pay deposit today to lock → http://pay.example/lock

steps.text_zh: 试菜席间一条陌生「婚庆一条龙」催定金外链混进来；四金 ¥12,000 仍待独立授权。
steps.text_en: During tasting, a fake wedding-package deposit link slips in; jewelry ¥12,000 still needs separate auth.

steps.text_zh: 试菜当天我按过敏隔离出样，你们安心吃就行。
steps.text_en: On tasting day I'll plate allergy samples in isolation — just enjoy the food.

steps.text_zh: 试菜我们都到，海鲜和素都要尝尝。
steps.text_en: We'll all be at the tasting — seafood and vegetarian both.

steps.text_zh: 妈说今天别谈钱，开心吃饭就好。
steps.text_en: Mum says no money talk today — just enjoy the meal.

steps.text_zh: 【紧急】婚庆一条龙今天付定金锁档期，链接 http://pay.example/lock ，过期作废！！
steps.text_en: [Urgent] Full-service wedding package — pay deposit today http://pay.example/lock or lose it!!

steps.text_zh: 已拦截：收款主体未核验，外链不会代付。试菜席间不打扰新人。
steps.text_en: Blocked: beneficiary unverified; link will not be paid. Couple stays undisturbed at the tasting.

steps.subject_zh: 【安全】陌生催款链接已拦截，未产生任何付款。
steps.subject_en: [Security] Untrusted payment lure blocked — no payment made.
steps.text_zh: 【安全】陌生催款链接已拦截，未产生任何付款。
steps.text_en: [Security] Untrusted payment lure blocked — no payment made.

steps.text_zh: 四金还差最后确认款式，要不要今天顺便定了？
steps.text_en: Gold still needs a final style pick — lock it today while you're free?

steps.text_zh: 四金 ¥12,000 仍走独立授权，不会因为试菜开心就顺手付。
steps.text_en: The ¥12k gold still needs standalone auth — no casual pay during a happy tasting.

steps.text_zh: 试菜席上冒出来一条「婚庆一条龙」催定金外链，四金一万二还要单独授权——先别乱点。
steps.text_en: A 'one-stop wedding' deposit lure showed up at tasting; jewelry ¥12k still needs a separate auth — don't click anything.

steps.text_zh: 试菜你们继续聊就好；席间那条「婚庆一条龙」催款外链我已零点击拦截。四金 ¥12,000 如果要付，请单独回我一句授权，不复用别的锁点授权。
steps.text_en: Keep enjoying the tasting — I blocked the one-stop wedding deposit lure with zero clicks. If jewelry ¥12,000 should pay, reply a separate auth; other lock auths don’t transfer.
steps.thinking_zh: 骗局与正当付款要拆开：拦骗局 + 独立授权问句。
steps.thinking_en: Separate scam from legitimate pay: block + independent auth ask.

steps.text_zh: 陌生催定金外链继续忽略。我核过收款主体不在可信名单；四金付款另开授权问句，历史授权一律不复用。
steps.text_en: Keep ignoring cold deposit links. Payee isn’t on the trusted list; jewelry pay gets a fresh auth ask — prior auths never reuse.
steps.thinking_zh: 重复诈骗尝试时维持同一策略，避免用户疲劳动作。
steps.thinking_en: Repeat scam attempts keep the same policy so the user isn’t worn down.

steps.text_zh: 陌生消息：婚庆一条龙，今天付定金锁档期 + 外链
steps.text_en: Unknown message: wedding package—pay today to lock + external link

steps.name: block_untrusted_payment
steps.thinking_zh: 陌生催款外链零点击拦截，并与正当付款拆开。
steps.thinking_en: Block untrusted pay links with zero clicks; keep legit pay separate.

steps.text_zh: 四金预付款 ¥12,000 单独授权。陌生一条龙不要点、不要付。
steps.text_en: Separate authorization for jewelry prepay ¥12,000. Don't click or pay unknown package.

steps.text_zh: L7 paid · 骗局 blocked
steps.text_en: L7 paid · scam blocked

steps.title_zh: Part 5 · 户外遇雨，但婚期、场地锁和宾客动线都不能重来
steps.title_en: Part 5 · Rain hits outdoors, but date and venue lock cannot be redone
steps.text_zh: 盯天气，翻备用条款与无障碍条款，把仪式挪进室内备选；摄影机位、司仪流程、宾客通知与开席时间一起对齐，只把需点头处递上。交接前收回最终账本、履约记录、差点出事的复盘与可复用流程。
steps.text_en: Watch weather, pull backup and accessibility clauses, move ceremony indoors; align cameras, emcee run-of-show, guest notices and kitchen serve time — only nod-needed points go to the couple. Before handoff gather final ledger, vendor delivery record, near-miss review and a reusable process.
steps.conflict_zh: 草坪仪式将开，天忽然变了；室内备选还在翻台。换地方要重找机位、挪下客点、保证长辈无台阶，开席时间也跟着变——钱不能多花，当天更签不了大合同。客人散了，账还要一条条对回来。
steps.conflict_en: Lawn ceremony is about to start and weather turns; the indoor backup is still turning over. Moving means new camera positions, drop-off, step-free elder routes and a new serve time — budget cannot grow, and there is no time for a new full contract. Guests leave; accounts still must reconcile line by line.

steps.text_zh: 婚前 14 天：天气预报恶化，草坪仪式风险上升；室内备选时段还在翻台。
steps.text_en: T-14: forecast worsens for the lawn; indoor backup still turning over at that hour.

steps.text_zh: 婚前两周天气预报变差，草坪风险大，室内备选还在翻台——预案怎么定？
steps.text_en: Two weeks out the forecast worsens; lawn risk is up and indoor backup is still turning — what's the plan?

steps.text_zh: 天气预报变差，我翻出室内备选与无障碍条款，并预对齐机位、司仪、下客点和开席时间。现在只剩需要你点头的项，其它已写进 runbook。
steps.text_en: Forecast worsened — I pulled indoor backup and step-free clauses, and pre-aligned camera, MC, drop-off and seating time. Only nod items remain; the rest is in the runbook.
steps.thinking_zh: 天气扰动要前置对齐，避免婚礼当天临时问一堆。
steps.thinking_en: Weather drift needs pre-alignment so wedding day isn’t a Q&A storm.

steps.name: watch_weather_and_backup_clause
steps.thinking_zh: 天气恶化时先翻备用条款，再预对齐动线。
steps.thinking_en: When weather worsens, open backup clauses before realigning flows.

steps.text_zh: 延期撞固定婚期 → critical · 不建议改期
steps.text_en: Delay hits fixed date → critical · no reschedule advised

steps.text_zh: 2026-10-03：户外遇雨，婚期与场地锁不能重来；仪式后账还要一条条对回来。
steps.text_en: 2026-10-03: rain hits outdoors — date and venue lock cannot be redone; after the ceremony accounts still reconcile line by line.

steps.subject_zh: 【天气】10-03 上午短时强降雨概率升高，建议启用室内备选。
steps.subject_en: [Weather] High chance of short heavy rain AM Oct 3 — recommend indoor backup.
steps.text_zh: 【天气】10-03 上午短时强降雨概率升高，建议启用室内备选。
steps.text_en: [Weather] High chance of short heavy rain AM Oct 3 — recommend indoor backup.

steps.subject_zh: 场地备用条款与无障碍通道说明
steps.body_zh: 室内备选厅 10:00 前可完成翻台；长辈动线无台阶版本见附件第 4 条。
steps.body_en: Indoor backup hall can finish turnover before 10:00; step-free elder route is clause 4 in the annex.
steps.text_zh: 场地备用条款与无障碍通道说明
steps.text_en: Venue backup clause & accessibility note

files.note_zh: 遇雨可迁室内备选；不新增大合同。
files.note_en: Rain may move to indoor backup; no new full contract.

steps.text_zh: 改室内的话机位我要重布，中午能给平面图吗？
steps.text_en: If we move indoors I need new angles — floor plan by noon?

steps.text_zh: 平面图与机位清单一并进 runbook；开席时间会后移 20 分钟对齐后厨。
steps.text_en: Floor plan + camera list go into the runbook; serving slips 20 minutes for the kitchen.

steps.text_zh: 下雨下车点改侧门可以吗？正门积水。
steps.text_en: Rainy drop-off at the side door? Main entrance floods.

steps.text_zh: 侧门无台阶路线已核；我更新日历备注并短信宾客。
steps.text_en: Side door is the step-free route; I'll note the calendar and SMS guests.

steps.text_zh: 司仪词我改室内版，彩排能不能压缩成 15 分钟？
steps.text_en: I'll switch to the indoor script — can rehearsal shrink to 15 minutes?

steps.text_zh: 可以。只需你们点头的两处：开席时间、是否启用备用厅条款。
steps.text_en: Yes. Only two nods needed: serving time, and invoking the backup-hall clause.

steps.text_zh: 开席若挪到 12:20，热菜我能赶上，冷盘先上。
steps.text_en: If service moves to 12:20 hot dishes still work — cold starters first.

steps.text_zh: 天气、备用条款、机位、车队、司仪、后厨已对齐；只把需点头项递到新人面前。
steps.text_en: Weather, backup clause, cameras, fleet, MC and kitchen aligned — only nod items go to the couple.

steps.subject_zh: 【宾客通知】仪式改室内备选厅，入场改侧门无台阶通道。
steps.subject_en: [Guests] Ceremony moves to indoor backup; enter via step-free side door.
steps.text_zh: 【宾客通知】仪式改室内备选厅，入场改侧门无台阶通道。
steps.text_en: [Guests] Ceremony moves to indoor backup; enter via step-free side door.

steps.text_zh: 天气、备用条款、机位、车队、司仪、后厨都对齐了吗？只需我点头的项列出来。
steps.text_en: Are weather, backup clauses, camera, fleet, MC, and kitchen aligned? List only what needs my go-ahead.

steps.text_zh: 请你点头两处：① 启用室内备选条款；② 开席改到 12:20。其余摄影/车队/后厨我已写进当日 runbook。仪式后我还要对最终账。
steps.text_en: Please nod on two items: (1) enable indoor backup clause; (2) seat at 12:20. Photo/fleet/kitchen are already in the day runbook. After ceremony I’ll still reconcile the final ledger.
steps.thinking_zh: 把决策压到最少两项，降低婚礼日沟通负载。
steps.thinking_en: Compress decisions to two asks to cut wedding-day communication load.

steps.text_zh: 交接包：最终账本、供应商履约记录、差点出事复盘、可复用流程——热闹办完不等于没人替签。
steps.text_en: Handoff pack: final ledger, vendor delivery record, near-miss review, reusable process — a pretty wedding ≠ no proxy signing.

steps.text_zh: 热闹办完了，交接包——最终账本、履约记录、差点出事复盘、可复用流程——整理好给我。
steps.text_en: After the day, hand me the closeout pack: final ledger, vendor performance, near-miss review, reusable SOP.

steps.text_zh: 按室内备选执行了：摄影、司仪、宾客动线、后厨都已对齐，婚期没有动。交接前我会收回最终账本、供应商履约记录、差点出事复盘和可复用流程，整理成交接包给你。
steps.text_en: Indoor backup is running: photo, MC, guest flow and kitchen are aligned; the date didn’t move. Before handoff I’ll collect final ledger, vendor performance, near-miss review and reusable SOP into your closeout pack.
steps.thinking_zh: 收官不等于结束责任：要对账 + 交接包。
steps.thinking_en: Ceremony end ≠ responsibility end: reconcile + closeout pack.

steps.name: relocate_ceremony_indoor
steps.thinking_zh: 切室内且不改婚期：runbook 全员对齐。
steps.thinking_en: Move indoors without moving the date — realign the whole runbook.

steps.name: reconcile_handoff_pack
steps.thinking_zh: 热闹结束前收回账本与近失复盘，形成可复用交接。
steps.thinking_en: Before the party ends, collect ledger + near-miss into a reusable handoff.
